main_text.p: ἀρχιεπισκόπου[?] Ἀδριανῷ[?] τῷ νεωτέρῳ Πάπᾳ. Ita tamen vt deinceps de laicis in eadem Ecclefia Episcopus contra sanctorum Patrum statuta nullatenus ordinetur, & omnis illa mala consuetudo ab inde penitus amputetur; iuxta capitulum, quod super hac re in Venerabili Synodo, tempore scilicet decessoris nostri Adriani iunio-ris Papæ, Constantinopoli habita, est congruentissime promulgatum. Est vero Actionis 10. Canon 5. Venerabilem nuncupat, & conculcari mandat? Sed Photius in corruptis vocat ἀδίκους Συνόδους, iniquas Synodos, & Canonem ad Septimam Synodum sub Adriano Primo Tarasij tempore refert. Quid tum? multa alia dixit Photius, quæ nec ab ipsis Schismaticis probantur. Hominem Nicolao, & Adriano Pontificibus infensissimum pro sui defensione, mirum est non peiora pronunciasse. Vide quæ nos in Opere de Consensione Occidentalis, atque Orientalis Ecclesiæ lib. 2. cap. 3. 4. & 5. diximus. Quibus colligitur, Synodum hanc a Photio confictam prorsus fuisse, uti & aliam, quam in Nicolaum, tot aduersus Romanam Ecclesiam criminationes ementitus pro arbitrio concinnauerat. page.notes: The Greek words at the start of the page are hard to read on the scan: ἀρχιεπισκόπου and Ἀδριανῷ are my best reading and are marked [?]. The Greek in the 'vocat' sentence (ἀδίκους Συνόδους) is also a reading from the scan. The left edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and the right side shows stains; neither is transcribed. The word "iunio-ris" is printed with a hyphen at the line end and is kept as printed.
